metadata.title: Tremelimumab and Durvalumab Therapy
metadata.indication: First-line treatment of adults with advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.
metadata.safety_correction: HCC eligibility, cycle-one-only tremelimumab, weight exceptions, immune toxicity, baseline-relative liver thresholds and recovery exceptions reconciled to NCCP 00926 v1.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent oncology and pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: HCC first-line eligibility, initial versus continuation dosing, tests and Table 2 component-specific toxicity decisions. Unknown causality or thresholds outside a source row require individual consultant review.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Discuss all changes with a consultant. The source does not recommend dose escalation or reduction. Evaluate suspected immune events and alternative causes before applying Table 2.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

indications.description: First-line treatment of adults with advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.
First-line advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.

administration.cycle_note: Cycle 1 only, one dose in this regimen.
administration.notes: One infusion only, over 60 minutes. At body weight ≤40 kg use 4 mg/kg instead of 300 mg. Use a separate filtered infusion line.
60-minute infusion. At body weight ≤30 kg use 20 mg/kg instead of 1500 mg. On cycle 1 start 60–120 minutes after tremelimumab ends.

treatment_phases.label: Cycle 2 onwards · durvalumab alone
treatment_phases.duration_text: Repeat every 28 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

administration.notes: 60-minute infusion. At body weight ≤30 kg use 20 mg/kg instead of 1500 mg. Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

output_templates.proceed: Review HCC indication, cycle, organ function, treatment toxicities and the current source with the oncology team before administering any due component.
output_templates.coverage_gap: One or more potentially relevant ICI domains were not assessed.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest active parenteral component is minimal emetogenic risk in NCCP V6 Table 7.

eligibility: First-line treatment of an adult with advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma
BCLC stage B or C; Child-Pugh A or B7; ECOG 0–2; adequate organ and marrow function.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to either medicine or an excipient; pregnancy; breastfeeding. Refer to NCCP guidance on prior anti-PD-1 / anti-PD-L1 treatment.

baseline: FBC, renal and liver profile, glucose, thyroid function tests, hepatitis B (surface antigen and core antibody) and hepatitis C.
Table 1 covers pre-existing kidney or liver impairment. Use the separate Table 2 pathways for suspected immune hepatitis or nephritis.
ongoing: Before every cycle: FBC, renal and liver profile, glucose and thyroid tests. Cortisol as clinically indicated. Disease monitoring follows the supervising consultant’s treatment plan.

treatment.schedule_summary: Cycle 1 day 1: tremelimumab once, then durvalumab. Each subsequent 28-day cycle: durvalumab alone until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
